title: p-Adic Dirac Equations and the Jackiw-Rebbi Model
summary: We present a new p-adic version of the Jackiw-Rebbi model. In the new model, the real numeric line is replaced by a p-adic line (the field of p-adic numbers Q_{p}), and the Dirac Hamiltonian is replaced by a non-local operator acting on complex-valued functions defined on Q_{p}. These Hamiltonians admit localized wavefunctions and allow long-range interactions, so spooky action at a distance is allowed. These features are not present in the original model.
